Estimate Your Program Costs
UMass Boston offers high-quality graduate programs at an incredible value. Use the Cost Calculator to explore estimated total program costs for master’s and certificate programs.
Graduate Program Cost Calculator
Results will appear below after you select all three options.
Loading...
Listed tuition rates are estimates based on information for the current academic year (2026-2027) and include mandatory fees and one-time fees. Tuition rates and fees are subject to change. For the most detailed and up-to-date cost information, please visit the Bursar’s office website.

Costs may vary based on individual circumstances.
Housing
On-campus housing is not available for graduate students. There are many off-campus housing options that can fit a graduate student’s preferences and budget. UMass Boston’s Office of Off-Campus Housing has professional staff and online resources available to assist graduate students with their off-campus housing search. The posted range of housing costs reflect multiple occupancy living arrangements and single occupancy accommodations.
Food
Food costs can vary greatly depending on your preferences. Many off-campus apartments offer kitchens where students can cook their own meals. Graduate students may choose to purchase a commuter or full-time meal plan based on their preferences.
Transportation
On-Campus Parking: $550 / semester
MBTA Discounted Pass: Cost varies based on selected option
Students may purchase a semester-long parking pass. Additionally, graduate students can qualify for discounted public transportation (MBTA) passes to get to and from UMass Boston.
Student Health Insurance*
Graduate students registered for seven or more credits per semester are required to participate in the University Student Health Insurance plan. Domestic students can waive health insurance costs by demonstrating proof of comparable health insurance coverage.
Student health insurance is billed on an annual basis. International students registered for one or more credits will be automatically enrolled in the Student Health Insurance Plan.
Financing Options
Financial Assistance
Our financial aid staff are available to answer your questions and guide you through the process. Contact Financial Aid Services at finaid@umb.edu or visit the university’s One Stop page to connect with a representative. In order to be considered for financial assistance, eligible applicants must fill out the Free Application for Federal Student Aid (FAFSA). Learn more about:
Grants
Loans
Federal Work-Study
Assistantships
UMass Boston supports graduate education primarily through assistantships. Assistantships are not awarded by Financial Aid Services. They are formal service contracts between you and your graduate school department. They may include:
a tuition credit
a waiver of fees
a stipend
The number of graduate assistantships are limited based on budget. Contact your Graduate Program Director for more information. Financial Aid Award Packages may be adjusted for students receiving assistantships.
Questions about assistantships? Contact finaid@umb.edu.
Student Employment
Student Employment Services (SES) works with UMass Boston students to assist them in finding on-and-off-campus job opportunities that fit into their busy academic schedules.
Learn more about open positions and next steps on our student employment webpage.
Questions about student employment opportunities? Contact ses@umb.edu.
Payment Information
UMass Boston offers several payment options, including a monthly payment plan. For more information, visit the Bursar’s website.
Contact Us
Have questions about the financial aid process or need help submitting your graduate program application? Contact graduate.admissions@umb.edu.
